issues: Fanfare effect is encoded with tutorFromCemetery to field, but the card says to summon an Alchemist follower that costs 3 or less from your cemetery. Encode it as a cemetery-to-field summon/select effect instead; the current engine lacks a direct 'summon selected card from cemetery' or equivalent targeted revival operation, so implement an ability for selecting a matching cemetery follower and summoning it.

Fanfare optional discard effect checks discardedCardType:follower twice, but the card requires 'If you discarded a Departed card, draw a card.' Replace this with a condition that checks the discarded card's trait is Departed; the engine currently lacks a discarded-card-trait condition, so implement a condition such as discardedCardTrait/ discardedCardMatches(filter).

On Evolve target selector adds a filter for identityName Ghost inside targets, but target selectors only support fields like maxCost/maxDef; encode the target as selecting a Ghost on your field with a supported targeting/filter mechanism instead of an invalid target shape.
On Evolve grants keyword ward, but the source says to give another follower on your field Aura. Change the granted keyword from ward to aura.

Fanfare is incomplete: it only summons a Naterran Great Tree token onto the field, but the source says you may put one onto your field or into your EX area. Encode this as a choice between summoning to field and summoning to EX area; if the engine cannot represent choosing between zones for the same token placement, implement support for a choose/optional zone-placement effect.

On Evolve is incorrect: searchDeckChoose with lookAt 5 and maxCost 2 does not match 'Search your deck for up to 2 Natura spells that cost a total of 2 or less, put them into your EX area, then shuffle.' It should search the whole deck, allow up to 2 cards, enforce total cost 2 or less, put them into EX area, then shuffle. The current engine lacks a deck search operation for multiple chosen cards with a total-cost cap, so implement a tutor/search effect supporting up to N chosen cards with max total cost and destination EX area.

Fanfare is left as noop placeholders. It should select a Princess's Strike in your cemetery and play it for 0 play points. Implement an operation for selecting and playing a spell from cemetery at modified cost, then replace the noop encoding.

Activated ability cost is incomplete: '[engage] 2 cards named Naterran Great Tree on your field' is not represented. The ability should require engaging this card and engaging/burying/otherwise paying with 2 Naterran Great Tree cards on your field as specified by the card text; implement a cost form that can engage or otherwise consume matching field cards by name and use it here.

Fanfare rolls a die twice with both effects applied to the controller, but the source says each player rolls a die and resolves their own result. Encode one die roll for you and one for the opponent with opponent-specific draw/discard resolution; the engine lacks opponent-targeted rollDie outcome effects such as opponentDraw/opponentDiscard, so implement opponent-side hand operations or a controller-targeted rollDie resolver.
